title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
*Location:* Hyderabad *Industry:* Hospitality / Resorts / Weddings & Conventions *Experience:* 3 to 6 Years *Employment Type:* Full-Time 
 ### About the Role 
 We are looking for a *Performance Marketing Manager* who can take complete ownership of our digital lead-generation activities and performance marketing ecosystem. 
 The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring and optimizing campaigns across *Meta, Facebook, Instagram, Google, YouTube and other relevant digital platforms, with a strong focus on generating **high-quality, conversion-oriented leads* for our resort, weddings, banquets, conventions and hospitality business. 
 This role requires someone who understands that *generating leads is only the beginning* the real objective is to generate the right leads, track their quality, analyse performance and continuously improve campaigns based on business outcomes. 
 ### Key Responsibilities 
 *1. Lead Generation & Campaign Management* 
 * Plan and execute lead-generation campaigns across Meta, Facebook, Instagram, Google and YouTube. * Manage campaigns from campaign planning to execution, optimization and reporting. * Develop strategies for generating leads for: 
 * Weddings & Events * Banquets * Conventions * Corporate Events * Resort Bookings * Staycation / Leisure * Other business requirements * Continuously monitor *lead volume, lead quality, cost per lead and conversion performance*. * Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action. 
 *2. Meta & Google Ads* 
 * Manage Meta Ads campaigns including Facebook and Instagram. * Manage Google Ads including Search, Display, Performance Max and other relevant campaigns. * Plan and manage YouTube advertising campaigns. * Conduct audience research, targeting, retargeting and remarketing. * Manage campaign budgets and optimize ad spend for maximum ROI. 
 *3. Lead Inflow & Tracking* 
 * Take ownership of the complete *digital lead inflow*. * Ensure leads are properly captured, categorized and transferred to the sales team. * Monitor lead sources and campaign-wise performance. * Coordinate with the sales team to understand: 
 * Valid leads * Invalid leads * Duplicate leads * Unresponsive leads * Qualified leads * Converted leads * Analyse why leads are not converting and recommend corrective strategies. 
 *4. Performance Analysis & Reporting* Prepare regular reports covering: 
 * Total leads generated * Platform-wise leads * Campaign-wise leads * Cost Per Lead (CPL) * Qualified / Valid Leads * Lead-to-Booking Conversion * Campaign ROI / ROAS * Ad Spend * Website performance * Enquiry trends * Audience performance * Month-on-month performance 
 Reports should provide *insights and actionable recommendations*, not just numbers. 
 *5. Strategy & Optimization* 
 * Develop monthly and quarterly digital marketing strategies. * Identify new target audiences and market opportunities. * Analyse competitor campaigns and market trends. * Recommend new campaigns, offers, creatives and targeting strategies. * Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, copy and landing pages. * Continuously optimize campaigns to improve lead quality and reduce acquisition costs. 
 *6. Website, Landing Pages & Tracking* 
 * Coordinate with the website/development team for landing pages and conversion optimization. * Monitor website enquiries, forms, WhatsApp enquiries and other digital conversion points. * Ensure proper tracking through relevant analytics and conversion-tracking tools. * Identify gaps in the customer journey from *Ad Lead Sales Follow-up Booking*. 
 *7. Creative & Content Coordination* 
 * Work closely with graphic designers, video editors and content teams. * Provide clear briefs for: 
 * Ad creatives * Reels * Videos * Banners * Campaign-specific content * Offers and promotional campaigns * Analyse creative performance and recommend what type of content should be produced. 
 *8. Sales Team Coordination* 
 * Work closely with the Sales Head and sales team. * Share campaign performance and lead-quality reports. * Take feedback from the sales team regarding lead quality. * Compare marketing-generated leads with actual sales outcomes. * Identify gaps between *lead generation and lead conversion*. * Use sales feedback to improve future campaigns. 
 ### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 The candidate will be evaluated on: 
 *LEAD GENERATION LEAD QUALITY CPL QUALIFIED LEADS SALES FOLLOW-UP CONVERSION ROI* 
 Key KPIs include: 
 * Quality of leads generated * Cost per qualified lead * Lead-to-conversion ratio * Campaign ROI / ROAS * Reduction in wasted ad spend * Growth in qualified enquiries * Campaign performance improvement * Accuracy and timeliness of reporting 
 ### Required Skills 
 * Strong knowledge of *Meta Ads Manager* * Strong knowledge of *Google Ads* * Facebook & Instagram advertising * YouTube advertising * Google Analytics / GA4 * Conversion tracking & pixels * Remarketing / retargeting * Audience segmentation * Lead-generation funnels * Campaign analytics * Excel / Google Sheets * Performance reporting * Basic understanding of landing-page optimization * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
 ### Ideal Candidate 
 We are looking for someone who is: 
 * *Data-driven* * Highly analytical * Result-oriented * Strong in campaign optimization * Comfortable working with numbers and reports * Able to identify problems independently * Able to coordinate with sales and creative teams * Proactive in suggesting new strategies * Focused on *business results, not just lead numbers* 
 ### Important 
 *We are NOT looking for someone who simply runs advertisements.* 
 We are looking for a performance marketer who can understand the complete funnel: 
 *CAMPAIGN LEAD GENERATION LEAD QUALITY SALES FOLLOW-UP CONVERSION REVENUE* 
 The candidate should be able to tell management *what is working, what is not working, why it is happening, and what should be done next.*Role & responsibilities
